d:
Is the Indian stock market poised for its next big rally? And is this the right time for investors to increase their equity exposure?
In this exclusive conversation, Anthony Heredia, MD & CEO of Mahindra Manulife AMC, shares his outlook on Indian markets, changing mutual fund flows, FII participation and investor behaviour. He explains why flexi-cap and multi-cap funds could be attractive, why investors should stay diversified, and how hybrid funds can help manage volatility.
